sources.facts: The preset form {name, maps[].{fileName, channels[].{destChannel, srcChannel, srcMapType, srcMapName}, parameters}}; the documentMap and virtualMap names used here; the $textureSet and $colorSpace wildcards and ( ... ) optional groups.
The metallic-roughness model's inputs: base colour, metalness, roughness; tangent-space normal textures with +Y up (the OpenGL convention).
A 256 px PNG export through this preset on a Painter sample scene produced Base Color, Roughness, Metallic, Normal and Height files.

packing.decision: Files named $textureSet_<map>, and no per-map parameters: file format, bit depth, padding and dithering come from exportParameters until the recording shows what the preset itself sets

pending.what: Painter's files and dry run for resource://starter_assets/PBR Metallic Roughness on a UzmiGames fixture with every channel the preset reads filled distinctly (emissive and opacity too, to see whether the preset has maps for them), with and without an exportParameters rule: confirms or corrects every map, its channels, its name, the preset's own parameters and the URL's version.
BaseColor (sRGB8) is exported sRGB-encoded; the encoding is recorded but not fitted (decision 090), so every export writing it is refused before writing.
